name: gaia
description: Read-only ecommerce operations intelligence for catalog, channels, orders, fulfillment, returns, and revenue.

interface.longDescription: Gaia helps ecommerce operators inspect their company’s catalog, channels, orders, invoices, fulfillment, returns, and revenue metrics through read-only data lookups.
defaultPrompt: Which live marketplace channels do I have?
Show active products with stock but no orders this quarter.
Break down validated revenue by channel for last month.

positive.description: List active marketplaces for the company.
positive.prompt: Which live marketplace channels do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching live marketplace channels with their names and IDs.

positive.description: Find inactive stock with no sales in a date window.
positive.prompt: Show active products with stock but no orders this quarter, sorted by stock value.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching products with inventory and sales metrics, ordered by stock value.

positive.description: Inspect revenue by channel for a month.
positive.prompt: Break down validated revenue by channel for June 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns revenue, margin, and order metrics grouped by channel for the requested period.

positive.description: Review return reasons and the most-returned products.
positive.prompt: What were our return reasons and top returned products last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns headline return metrics, reason breakdowns, and top returned products for the period.

positive.description: Look up a known order by its order reference.
positive.prompt: Find the details for order GAIA-10001.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching order’s status, amounts, channel, fulfillment details, and products.

negative.description: Do not trigger for a request to edit product data.
negative.prompt: Change the price of SKU ABC-123 to 99 euros.

negative.description: Do not trigger for a request to forecast future performance.
negative.prompt: Forecast next quarter’s revenue using market trends.

negative.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated personal productivity request.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: Gaia provides ecommerce operations data but does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Gaia’s read-only ecommerce operations data tools.
